svg.text: Triangle budget: 800k for the whole area
Design estimates, not measured. Evaluated triangles, every instance counted, text curves included, as the room validators count.
Planned 700,740 of 800,000; reserve 99,260 (12%) is held back for hero pieces, LOD slack and review changes.
The repo flags rooms over 400k, so this area needs that noted when it goes to review.
Ground: Concrete slabs, bevelled, 4 m grid
Ground: Drain trenches and recessed puddles
Ground: Kerbs, steps and loading apron
Mountain edge: Cliff wall and rock shelf, hero kitbash
Mountain edge: Retaining wall and mine portal surround
Rail: Mine cart track, rails and 64 ties
Boundary: Fence panels and vehicle gate (evacuation)
Structures: Porch canopy and smoking shelter
Structures: Loading canopy over the refinery gate
Structures: Generator, fuel tank, water tank
Structures: Pipe runs and mine-water riser
Shell: Floor, walls, high windows, door frames
Kitchen: Serving counter and kitchen block
Lounge: Coffee table, shelf, TV wall
Appliances: Coffee machine, water cooler, fridge
Small props: Trays, mugs, bottles, magazines, bins
Shell: Floor, walls, ceiling bays, clerestory
Doors: Three heavy blast doors with frames and lights
Doors: West and east end doors
Gantry: Gantry landing, stair and rails over the spine door
Safety: Eyewash, first aid, fire cabinet, PPE return
Desk: Shift desk kiosk with monitors
Signage: Direction signs, floor route lines, status board
Roof: Roof deck, trusses and gutters over cafeteria and hall
Structure: Portal frames, columns, wall plates
Connectors: West colonnade, east trunk threshold, spine mouth
Painted steel, ochre and orange accent
Rubber mat and hall floor strip
Crate, cardboard and tarp prop atlas
Shared families, no unique textures per prop. A view
from the yard also sees the mountain and refinery,
so check the per-view material cap with those loaded.
Props are instanced; each instance still counts.
Bevels come from normal maps on props; geometry
only on silhouettes the player sees up close.
Cliff is one hero kitbash (85k); nothing else is hero.
Junk is built from six cheap prop families.
Trees use crossed low-poly crowns, not leaves.
The 86k reserve is not allocated to any item.
Measure with the room validator once built; these
numbers are what to design to, not a result.
